# Automatic reporting of GHR model selection functions.

## Description

Generates reports of the semi-automatic model selection carried out by select_re or select_fe . It requires `rmarkdown` to be run.

```r
select_report(select_out, output_file, quiet = TRUE)
```

## Arguments

- `select_out`: A GHRselect_re generated by select_re or a GHRselect_fe object generated by select_fe .
- `output_file`: A character indicating the output file.
- `quiet`: Logical; if `TRUE` (default), suppresses the knitting progress and pandoc command printed by `rmarkdown::render()`.

## Returns

Silent output path where the html report is saved.

## See Also

select_re , select_fe

## Examples

```r
## Not run:

# Read data
library(sf)
data(dengue_MS)
dengue_MS <- dengue_MS[complete.cases(dengue_MS), ]

# Compute graph
data(map_MS)
nb <- spdep::poly2nb(map_MS)
g <- spdep::nb2mat(nb, style = "B")

# Prepare indices
dengue_MS$spatial_id <- as.numeric(as.factor(dengue_MS$micro_code))
dengue_MS$seasonal_id <- dengue_MS$month
dengue_MS$year_id <- dengue_MS$year

# Prepare precision priors
prec1 <- list(prec = list(prior = "pc.prec", param = c(0.5, 0.01)))
prec2 <- list(prec = list(prior = "pc.prec", param = c(0.25, 0.01)))

# Run RE model selection
dengue_re <- select_re(
  data = dengue_MS,
  outcome = "dengue_cases",
  prior = c("prec1", "prec2"),
  offset_var = "pop100000",
  time = "date",
  unit = "micro_name"
)

# Generate report
select_report(dengue_re, file.path(tempdir(), "random_effects.html"))
## End(Not run)
```
